store.0: Patient with Type 2 Diabetes on metformin 1000 mg twice daily. A1C around 6.9%. Recently added semaglutide(Ozempic) at low dose for better blood sugar control and appetite management. Fasting blood sugar typically between 125-130 mg/dL.
store.1: Patient on losartan 50 mg once daily for hypertension. Blood pressure typically ranges 135-140/80-90 mmHg. Doctor recommends stress management and reduced sodium intake instead of increasing dosage. Taking daily magnesium supplement for potential blood pressure support.
